motivation: Post hoc follow-up to the strict-cap one-probe ADWIN deadlock; not confirmatory.
bootstrap_rule: one early probe at batch 1 and one fixed midpoint probe at batch 12, both within the declared audit budget
selection_signal: two initial probes or an ADWIN event from selected, released row-level errors
warnings: This schedule was devised after inspecting the one-probe result and is exploratory.
It reuses the same predictions and labels; it is not independent confirmation.
Two early probes consume two of the available audit cohorts; strict-cap policy volume differs from one-probe ADWIN.
ADWIN monitors supervised error and cannot detect input drift without labels.
variant: midpoint two-probe schedule; exploratory sensitivity following one-probe deadlock and adjacent early-probe non-detection
supersedes: adwin_midpoint_probe_sensitivity_20261118_v1 (invalid: compared stream clock to cohort budget and skipped clock-12 probe for budgets below 12)
probe_budget_gate: probe is selected when its fixed stream clock is reached and at least one cohort of budget remains
